payload.summary: Draft PRs show a green PR-required gate while twelve heavy CI jobs stay skipped, so draft status is easy to misread as merge-ready
payload.detail: Improve draft-status visibility (UI/docs/bot messaging) so a green draft is never treated as a full readiness signal. Why: .github/workflows/ci.yml still skips twelve heavy jobs while github.event.pull_request.draft == true (static-heavy, coverage, build, Production UI, Production UI critical, Ward Flow, Lighthouse and more), so draft 'PR required' is weaker than it looks. This is NOT a merge hole: pull_request triggers include ready_for_review, and undrafting re-runs the full workflow before the change can reach main (see .github/workflows/ci.yml ready_for_review trigger and the comment that undrafting re-runs full CI). Do not change standing draft policy or narrow the skip list to 'close' a nonexistent merge path — fix operator/assistant messaging instead. Context: PR #2909 sat as a draft with zero browser coverage; npm run plan:browser already names the draft case. Owner: assistant (messaging) / user (policy if desired). Confidence: high — draft skip verified by grep; ready_for_review re-run path verified in ci.yml. Depends on: nothing.
payload.source: session 2026-09-20 /ledger sweep — nine-agent repo maturity review
